tools.name: search_books
tools.description: Search the public library of bilingual audiobooks. All filters are optional; values within one filter are OR'd, different filters are AND'd. With no arguments, lists every public book, easiest first. Returns one page of books (see has_more and page) with each book's id, title, author, languages, CEF

tools.name: get_book
tools.description: Get one public audiobook by id: title, author, languages, CEFR level, audience, length, and links to its reader page, audio and share image.

tools.name: read_book
tools.description: Read a public audiobook's bilingual text: its sentence pairs (each original sentence with its translation, plus a Latin-script romanization for languages that have one), in reading order. Returns at most `limit` pairs starting at `offset`; continue with offset + limit while has_more is true. total_p

tools.name: find_related_books
tools.description: Find other public audiobooks in the same target language as a given book: the books its reader page recommends. Optionally narrow them to a learner's CEFR level (or the nearest level that has books).

tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: List every content language books are written in or translated into: its code (used by the other tools), English and native names, and how many public books are translated into it. Optionally render the names in a display locale (e.g. 'es').
